**Limitations**

- Approximate. The Radon round trip alone loses fine detail. In the worked example it caps thin lines at about 29 dB even without noise.
- Curved edges spread over many angles, so they gain nothing.
- The noise in the sinogram is not white, so the noise level of a projection is only an average.
- Slow for large images.

**Artifacts**

- Faint streaks along the angles of strong lines.
- The blur of the Radon round trip on fine detail.
